item.description:
Cloud sessions, OpenCode 2 and a filter for the list
- Claude Code and Cursor cloud sessions are listed beside your local ones - Type to filter the list: move through what you typed with the arrow keys, select it, copy it - OpenCode 2 works: its sessions are listed, and Perch answers its permissions and questions (thanks @yoavmmn) - Preview: Space shows the agent's whole last message on the card (thanks @stolery) - Replying to Codex in a terminal sends, instead of sitting in its field (thanks @stolery) - Opening a reply no longer brings Perch forward (thanks @namearth5005)

Pull requests, Cursor and agterm
- Sessions show their pull requests: green open, purple merged, red closed, orange when one needs you. Hover for details, click to open - Turn on Checks and a pull request with failing checks, asked-for changes or a conflict puts its session under Needs you - Cursor chats show up beside your other sessions (beta): Pick up the exact chat, reply, and answer Allow or Deny from the notch - Works with agterm like cmux: Pick up goes to the exact session and pane, and replies are typed into it (thanks @jeniasaigak)

Claude tasks and chats in Perch
- Your Claude app tasks show up beside your coding sessions: working, waiting for your OK, or finished, with what Claude found - Turn on Claude chats in Settings to see Claude's last reply, and answer from the notch - Choosing your apps uses simple checks, with Claude as one tile for Code, Tasks and Chats - Press R right after sending and the reply opens on your message, with the step the agent is on below it - A reply to a terminal session goes only into its own tab. When Perch isn't sure which tab, it copies the reply instead - Warp sessions open on their own tab at once, with no tab flicking (thanks @stolery)

Send feedback from the notch
- Settings has a Send feedback page: your words, files, an optional email, and Return sends - Drop, paste or attach files (Command+O), pictures shrink to fit, and Email it instead is there if it can't send - Settings is a short list of categories, and each row says what it is set to - The Version row shows your update right on the list - The Claude app's side chats no longer show up in the list

See your reply land
- A reply sent from the notch ends on a Sent line, so you know it went - The shortcut that opens Perch opens the question the notch is showing - New sessions started in the Claude app send again, also right after you trust the folder - Cancel Claude's trust question and the notch says Didn't start at once, your words kept - What's new keeps its place as you scroll, and scrolling lists no longer jitter

Answer a question in your own words
- When an agent asks you to choose, Other lets you type your own answer right on the card - Perch looks for updates every hour and says so with a quick peek in the notch; nothing installs until you press Update - A question's choices light one at a time under the pointer, and each choice's note shows in full - On the notch, Command+Option+O opens the session in its app, and clicking the question opens it on the card - An OpenCode answer with a comma in it stays one answer
